name: Ferienwohnung Mairhofer
beschreibung: The Ferienwohnung Mairhofer in Thiersee, Tirol, is located directly on the Thiersee and offers a quiet location amidst the mountain world. The rural surroundings and the fresh Alpen air create a relaxed atmosphere. Guests can expect a modern and cozy accommodation with full amenities. Nearby there are hiking trails, cycling routes and the lake for water sports activities. In winter, ski areas such as Kaiserwinkl are quickly reachable. Thus, the holiday apartment is equally suitable for those seeking relaxation and active guests.
